coverLetter.title: Professional Summary
coverLetter.content: Frontend-focused Full Stack Developer with 4 years of commercial experience building production web and mobile applications for B2B products. Strong expertise in React, TypeScript, and modern frontend architecture. Proven track record in developing pixel-perfect user interfaces and delivering scalable solutions. Hands-on experience with React Native and full-stack development using Node.js (Express, NestJS).

items.description: - React Native CRM apps: migrated the application to Expo, speeding up development and adding web support; reduced build time from 30 to 10 minutes. - Designed the module structure for a customer portal for machinery buyers; implemented REST API and WebSocket integration. - Built an app for weighing equipment: real-time data streaming, responsive UI, and hardware integration (100+ live parameters such as weight, temperature, geolocation, etc.). - Stack: React Native, Expo, TypeScript, REST API, WebSocket, React, Node.js, Jotai, PostgreSQL.

- Part of the admin portal and backend infrastructure team. - Delivered new admin panel modules for content and device management from scratch: architecture design and full-stack implementation. - Deeply refactored an SVG-based map editor: redesigned rendering logic, improved performance and extensibility, enabling delivery of 10+ new tools per month. - Designed and shipped a support module end-to-end (DB design to UI), cutting ticket handling time from 2 days to < 1 hour. - Expanded statistics collection and visualization: added 20+ metrics, optimized filtering, and moved heavy computations server-side. - Stack: React, Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, REST API, SVG.

- Completed an intensive one-year full-stack web development program. - Successfully delivered multiple team projects with rigorous code reviews. - Established a strong foundation in React, Node.js, and full-stack development best practices.
